blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 人类认知状态(如分心,压力),凝视,行为与驱动环境相互作用,其巧妙方式是AI可以用来帮助驱动器,但人类认知状态水平的地真相标签在规模上是昂贵的. 我们提出一个多模式的遮掩分解自编码器(ID-MAE),它增加了一个自我监督的缺陷预测目标:除了将被遮掩的缺陷标签预测为被遮掩的标志外,它还重建了被遮掩的目光和轨迹. 为了探究不同模式和类型缺陷对模型推论的影响,我们引入了DIVERT, 一个驱动模拟器数据集,包含103小时的驱动数据(n = 109),包含十种跨越认知、视觉和情感状态的缺陷诱导,并用凝视、车辆状态和场景视频记录。 我们证明了ID-MAE如何大大改进了DIVERT数据集和现有数据集的缺陷推论结果,并使得在轨迹和视线预测等额外任务方面能够取得强有力的成果。 对于位置相匹配的一对,我们的型号在DIVERT上实现了0.706的一对AUC来检测障碍,而0.590没有重建损失,比现有的基线有所改善. 我们从输入模式、掩码方案、位置编码、注意力机制以及解码等方面探索设计空间。 我们还调查培训和推论中各种缺陷之间的相互作用,表明视觉要求的分心与认知分心是分开的。 守则和数据一经接受即可提供。

blocks.en: The interaction of human cognitive state, gaze, and behavior lies at the core of human safety approaches [ 73 , 106 ] . Reasoning about driver safety require us to understand the interplay between these over prolonged periods of time and across several modalities. For instance, consider reasoning about a driver ignoring a stopped vehicle in front of them – their fixations on the dashboard or nearby objects may be signs of whether they are distracted, tasked, or tired. However, the space of all multimodal behavior and attention sequences is prohibitively large. Within the distribution of these sequences, risk-critical factors may not be strongly observed; for example, cognitive distraction may surface only as a slight narrowing of visual scanning and marginally delayed responses to peripheral events. Self-supervised approaches for temporal signal analysis have proven invaluable [ 66 , 26 ] , especially where labels are scarce [ 99 ] or noisy [ 33 ] . In inherently multimodal inference tasks, such as those connecting gaze, behaviors, and latent cognitive factors, leveraging self-supervision becomes a challenging yet crucial aspect of the solution. A limited amount of data for risk-relevant, rare events [ 30 , 23 ] , as well as the high-dimensional nature of the behavior observation sequences, thus requires us to draw supervision from the behavior itself rather than from labels alone.
blocks.zh: 人类认知状态、目光和行为的相互作用是人类安全方法的核心[73、106]。 关于驾驶员安全性的理由要求我们理解这些长期和几种方式之间的相互作用。 例如,考虑关于司机在他们面前无视被拦截车辆的推理 — — 他们在仪表板上或附近物体上的固定可能是他们分心、任务或疲劳的迹象。 然而,所有多式联运行为和关注序列的空间都非常之大。 在这些序列的分布中,风险关键因素可能得不到强烈的观察;例如,认知的分散可能只是略微缩小视觉扫描和略微推迟对外围事件的反应。 事实证明,自我监督的时间信号分析方法是宝贵的[66,26],特别是在标签很少[99]或吵闹[33]的情况下。 在内在的多模式推论任务中,例如那些将视线、行为和潜在的认知因素联系起来的任务,利用自我监督成为解决方案的一个挑战性但至关重要的方面。 有限数量的与风险相关,罕见的事件的数据[30,23],以及行为观察序列的高维度性质,因此要求我们从行为本身而不是仅仅从标签中提取监督.

blocks.en: We probe self-supervision on driving data with impairment type labels, formulating it as multimodal masked-diffusion inference, and examine how jointly modeling several impairments and driver behavior affects impairment detection. This requires richer data than existing impaired-driving datasets, which are small [ 80 ] , lack scene video or agent trajectories [ 46 ] , are collected under different levels of vehicle automation [ 20 ] , or limited in impairment categories [ 39 ] . Thus, the contributions of this work include:
blocks.zh: 我们对带有缺陷类型标签的驱动数据进行自我监督,将其表述为多模式遮掩扩散推论,并审查联合模拟几种缺陷和驱动行为如何影响缺陷检测。 这需要比现有的受损驾驶数据集更丰富的数据,这些数据集是小[80],缺乏场景视频或代理轨迹[46],是在不同的车辆自动化水平下收集的[20],或者限于损坏类别[39]。 因此,这项工作的贡献包括:

blocks.en: • We propose Impaired Driving MAE ( ID-MAE ), a model leveraging gaze, trajectories, scene video, and driver impairment state via a masked diffusion approach. It uses multimodal self-supervision and joint training on impairment tasks for improved impairment detection, while also generating gaze and trajectory predictions. • We introduce Driving with Impairments in Varied Everyday Realistic Tasks ( DIVERT ): a new dataset of diverse, controlled driver impairments, scenarios, and hazards. • We establish baselines on DIVERT and demonstrate that ID-MAE outperforms existing baselines on DIVERT and the Impaired Driving Dataset (IDD) [ 30 ] . Masked reconstruction of behavioral modalities substantially improves impairment detection over label supervision alone. We analyze per-impairment performance and report the benefit of joint training across impairment types.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议使用隐蔽扩散方式, 以模拟视觉、轨迹、场景影像及驾驶障碍状态。 它利用多式自制和联合培训,提高缺陷检测能力,同时产生视线和轨迹预测。 我们介绍在日常现实任务(DIVERT)中带有障碍的驾驶: • 新的数据集,包括各种不同的、可控制的驱动力障碍、情景和危害。 我们确定DIVERT的基线,并证明ID-MAE的绩效超过了DIVERT和缺陷驱动数据集的现有基线[30]. 假面重建行为模式大大改进了对缺陷的检测,而不仅仅是标签监督。 我们分析每个缺陷的性能,并报告各种缺陷类型联合培训的好处。

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Cognitive distraction has long been characterized through its effects on visual scanning, workload, and vehicle control [ 73 , 82 ] ,
and can be detected from behavioral and physiological signals using learned models [ 52 ] .
A large body of work targets automatic detection of impaired or otherwise negative driver states [ 78 ] , from vehicle-control, physiological, gaze, and video signals [ 53 , 59 , 98 , 47 , 51 , 1 , 77 , 96 ] .
Multimodal models with gaze/attention have explored baseline and impaired driving (see [ 95 , 2 ] and references therein), with recent datasets adding modalities [ 20 ] or latent factors [ 30 ] .
Because impairment labels are scarce, some works reduce supervision via visual contrastive learning [ 48 , 104 ] and with unsupervised learning over vehicle, physiological, and surrounding-object signals [ 69 ] , while other works probe generalization to unseen individuals [ 72 , 13 , 9 ] .
We instead train one generative model whose masked targets include the impairment label alongside gaze and trajectory. Reconstructing behavior provides self-supervision, and supervising impairment types jointly can improve detection.
blocks.zh:
认知分散长期以来一直通过它对视觉扫描、工作量和车辆控制的影响[73、82],
并且可以用学习过的模型从行为和生理信号中检测到[52].
大量工作的目标是自动检测受损或负司机,说明[78] 从车辆控制、生理、目视和视频信号[53、59、98、47、51、1、77、96]。
有目光/注意的多式联运模型探索了基线和有缺陷的驾驶(见[95,2]及其中的参考),最近的数据集增加了模式[20]或潜在因素[30]。
由于缺陷标签很少,有些作品通过视觉对比性学习减少监督[48,104],并且对车辆,生理,周边物体信号进行无监督的学习[69],而其他作品则探索对隐形个体的概括[72,13,9].
相反,我们培养了一个基因模型,其蒙面目标包括视线和轨迹上的减值标签。 重建行为提供自我监督,共同监督缺陷类型可以改善检测.

blocks.en: Masked autoencoders (MAEs) have been extended to video [ 29 , 31 ] and other modalities [ 8 , 61 ] , unified sequence models handle many tasks and modalities as token sequences with masked denoising among their pretraining objectives [ 57 ] , and iterative unmasking [ 14 ] underlies many generative variants. For motion data, masked trajectory models randomize which parts of a trajectory are hidden to support prediction, imputation, and representation learning [ 91 , 63 ] . Joint masking over 2D and 3D representations has also been used for point-cloud pretraining [ 34 ] , motivating our geometry-aware masking. We combine modality-level masking with temporal windows so a single task-agnostic objective covers prediction and imputation, as well as impairment inference when the label is masked.
blocks.zh: 蒙面自动编码器(MAEs)被扩展至视频[29,31]和其他模式[8,61],统一序列模型处理许多任务和模式,作为符号序列,在其预训目标中蒙面去命名[57],迭代解码[14]是许多基因变体的基础. 对于运动数据,遮蔽的轨迹模型随机排列一个轨迹的哪些部分被隐藏起来,以支持预测,推算和表现学习[91,63]. 2D和3D以上的联合遮罩也被用于点云预训[34],激发我们的几何感知遮罩. 我们把模式层面的遮盖与时间窗口结合起来,所以一个单一的任务不可知的目标涵盖预测和推算,以及掩盖标签时的减值推论.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Architecture overview. Gaze, trajectory, video, and impairment tokens are split into clean tokens, which the model sees as context, and noised tokens (dashed), which it learns to reconstruct. Unimodal encoders embed each modality, and a multimodal encoder fuses them. Decoders then denoise the noised tokens in a U-Net-like fashion. Video serves as encoded context only and is not decoded.
blocks.zh: 图2:建筑概况。 盖泽,轨迹,视频,和减值符被分为干净符,模型视其为上下文,和噪声符(dashed),它学会重建. 单式编码器嵌入每种模式,一种多式编码器将其引信。 解码器随后以U-Net的类似方式将噪声的代币揭开. 视频仅作为编码上下文,没有解码.

blocks.en:
Diffusion models have been used for self-supervised pretraining [ 11 , 60 , 94 ] and semi-supervised learning [ 97 , 37 ] . MAE diffusion has been used for representation learning [ 88 , 35 ] and prediction [ 55 ] , with masked generation complementing denoising-only training [ 92 , 87 ] and encouraging information bottlenecks [ 90 ] . Our decoder uses per-token noise level, similar to [ 15 ] ; rather than sampling independent levels, we share one sampled step across the noised tokens, tying the noise to the modality and window mask, and supply the level to the decoder as an attention bias. We jointly diffuse continuous signals (gaze, trajectory) and a discrete label using an absorbing-state process [ 7 ] , closely related to masked discrete diffusion for language [ 75 , 56 , 64 ] and related approaches [ 101 ] .
Multimodal diffusion for generation has been explored with continuous latents [ 10 ] , masked discrete tokens [ 83 ] , and mixed continuous and discrete modalities via a language-modeling loss combined with diffusion [ 103 ] or a joint process over arbitrary state spaces [ 74 ] ; masked diffusion has also been used for audio-video representation learning [ 65 ] . These mostly target generation, whereas we infer a latent state and impute or predict missing behavior. Beyond driving, diffusion enables imputation of multivariate time-series [ 85 , 71 , 3 ] ; time-series foundation models [ 32 , 5 , 21 ] focus on univariate series and do not leverage geometric relations between signals. Latent-variable models [ 44 ] , including diffusion variants [ 22 , 4 ] , have mostly addressed isolated prediction or classification.
blocks.zh:
传播模式被用于自我监督的预训[11,60,94]和半监督学习[97,37]. MAE的传播被用于表现学习[88,35]和预测[55],其中蒙面一代补充了唯名化培训[92,87]和鼓励信息瓶颈[90]. 我们的编解码器使用与 [ 15] 相似的每位噪声级别;我们不是对独立的级别进行采样,而是共享一个经过采样的跨噪声符号的阶梯,将噪声与模式和窗口遮罩捆绑起来,向编解码器提供级别作为注意偏差. 我们利用吸收状态过程[7]共同传播连续信号(信号、轨迹)和一个离散标签,这与语言的遮蔽离散扩散[75、56、64]和相关方法[101]密切相关。
利用连续潜质[10]、蒙面离散符号[83]和混合连续离散模式探索了多模式的生成扩散,这些模式是语言模型损失,再加上扩散[103]或针对任意状态空间的联合进程[74];蒙面扩散还被用于音频-视频代表学习[65]。 这些大多是目标生成者, 而我们推断出一种潜在的状态, 并指责或预测缺失的行为。 除驱动外,扩散还能对多变的时间序列进行推算[85,71,3];时间序列基础模型[32,5,21]注重单向序列,不利用信号之间的几何关系. 慢变模型[44],包括扩散变体[22,4],大多涉及孤立的预测或分类.

blocks.en:
Trajectory prediction has standard benchmarks [ 27 , 89 ] , strong attention-based models [ 63 , 62 , 81 ] , and diffusion-based forecasters [ 42 , 58 , 102 ] . These forecast agent motion from scene context alone, without driver gaze or latent state;
Gaze modeling spans saliency [ 40 , 38 ] , scanpath prediction [ 6 , 49 ] , focus of attention [ 68 , 28 ] , and, recently, diffusion-based gaze generation [ 43 , 45 ] . Some works have used gaze and field-of-view to condition ego-trajectory prediction [ 2 , 54 ] . We instead jointly model gaze, trajectory, and scene.
blocks.zh:
轨迹预测有标准基准[27,89],强关注模型[63,62,81],扩散预测器[42,58,102]. 这些预测剂运动仅从场景背景,没有驱动器视线或潜伏状态;
盖兹建模跨度显著[40,38],扫描路径预测[6,49],关注焦点[68,28],以及最近基于扩散的凝视生成[43,45]. 一些作品使用了视线和视场来进行条件自负-弹射预测[2,54]. 我们共同模拟视线、轨迹和场景。

blocks.en: 3 Model
blocks.zh: 3 型号

blocks.en:
Our model ( Figure 2 ) is an encoder–decoder transformer trained as a masked diffusion model in the style of DiffMAE [ 88 ] . We extend it from images to
four modalities (gaze, trajectory, video and impairment), diffusing the impairment label as a discrete token alongside the continuous signals, and incorporate geometric relative attention.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型(图2)是一个编码器-解码器变压器,作为DiffMAE[88]风格的蒙面扩散模型训练. 我们把它从图像扩展到
四种方式(gaze、轨迹、视频和减值),将减值标签与连续信号一起作为离散的标志,并包含几何相对注意。

blocks.en: Each modality is a grid of tokens over a time axis T T and a within-frame axis W W (agents for trajectory, image patches for video, W = 1 W{=}1 for gaze and impairment). Visible ( clean ) tokens are embedded by per-modality unimodal encoders and fused by a multimodal encoder . Hidden ( noised ) tokens are corrupted by forward diffusion and denoised by a multimodal decoder followed by per-modality unimodal decoders . Video is context only: its masked tokens are hidden from the encoder but never decoded or supervised.
blocks.zh: 每种模式都是在时间轴T T 和内框轴W W(用于弹道的代理,用于视频的图像补丁,用于视线和减值的W = 1 W = 1)上的信号格. 可见(干净)符号由单式编码器嵌入,由多式编码器熔化。 隐藏的(注音的)代号由于前向扩散而损坏,代号为多式联运解码器,然后是单式单式解码器。 视频仅是上下文:其蒙面的代币隐藏在编码器中,但从未解码或监督.

blocks.en: The offsets are the differences in time index, agent index and diffusion step, plus a geometric offset. Clean tokens have step zero, so the step offset is how a noised query learns its timestep. Between two sensor tokens (gaze, or a video patch’s center), the geometric offset is the difference in viewing direction ( ψ , ϑ ) (\psi,\vartheta) . Otherwise, it is the key’s displacement, bearing and elevation as seen from a viewpoint: the query agent’s heading for two trajectory tokens, or the ego looking along the sensor token’s viewing direction for a sensor token and an agent. blocks.en: The multimodal encoder stacks N mm = 5 N_{\mathrm{mm}}=5 blocks over the unimodal encodings 𝒛 u \bm{z}_{u} of the clean tokens. Each block has a temporal layer, in which a token attends to the clean tokens of its own modality over time within a local window, and a cross-modal layer, in which it attends to the clean tokens of all modalities at the nearest time index. A 10 Hz gaze or impairment token thus reads the nearest 2 Hz trajectory and video tokens, and the bias keeps the residual time offset ( Section 3.1 ). Each modality has its own query and output projections and feed-forward block, and in the cross-modal layer each query–key modality pair has its own key and value projections and its own MLP pos \mathrm{MLP}_{\mathrm{pos}} . The output of every block, 𝒛 ( 1 ) , … , 𝒛 ( N mm ) \bm{z}^{(1)},\dots,\bm{z}^{(N_{\mathrm{mm}})} , is cached.

modalities (trajectory, gaze, video) is kept available ; the others
are dropped from the input, and the impairment label is always available. Second, a
non-empty subset of the available modalities is noised . It must include at least one
decoded modality, and it may include the impairment label, so an example trains reconstruction with the label as context, label prediction, or both. Third, the
noised continuous modalities share one contiguous window 𝒯 ξ \mathcal{T}_{\xi} of length 4 4 – 12 12 s, chosen with equal probability to end at the clip end (future
prediction) or to lie in the clip interior (interpolation). Tokens inside 𝒯 ξ \mathcal{T}_{\xi} are
noised, and the impairment label, when noised, is masked for the whole clip.

blocks.en: 4.1 Contribution
blocks.zh: 4.1 贡献

blocks.en: While there are existing public datasets with driving impairments (see Table 2 ), DIVERT is designed to cover a wide variety of impairment categories while preserving consistent rich modalities, supplying reproducible driving environments and hazards, and providing ample scale for training multimodal deep models.
blocks.zh: 虽然现有有驾驶障碍的公共数据集(见表2),但设计DIVERT是为了涵盖各种类型的驾驶障碍,同时保留一致的丰富模式,提供可复制的驾驶环境和危险,并为培训多式联运深层模式提供充足的规模。

blocks.en: DIVERT contains 103.3 hours of simulator driving data collected in CARLA [ 24 ] from 109 participants. It spans 46.42 hours of driving under ten ‘induction’ techniques covering four impairment categories – cognitive distraction, frustration and stress, visual distraction, and cognitive load. For more information, see the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: DIVERT包含109名参与者在CARLA收集的103.3小时模拟驾驶数据[24]. 驾驶时间为46.42小时,使用十种 " 诱导 " 技术,涵盖四种障碍类别:认知分散、沮丧和压力、视觉分散和认知负荷。 更多信息见补充材料。

blocks.en: DIVERT includes synchronized forward scene video with impairment labels, vehicle trajectories, and control inputs – with driver-facing signals including eye gaze and periodic surveys of driver cognitive load, fatigue, and emotional state. It includes a set of six controlled road hazard categories such as parked car pop-outs and red light runners. The dataset will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: DIVERT包括带有减值标签的同步前方场景视频,车辆轨迹,以及控制输入 — — 带有驱动信号,包括眼睛凝视和对驾驶员认知负荷、疲劳和情绪状态的定期调查。 其中包括一套6个可控道路危险类别,如停放的汽车爆破和红灯跑车。 数据集将公开提供。

blocks.en: The dataset was collected in three ‘Phases,’ hereafter Phase 1 (Naturalistic), Phase 2 (Impaired), and Phase 3 (Hazardous). Beginning in Phase 1, participants drove through a town setting with a gamified task as ‘delivery drivers’ following a bespoke GPS app, with the opportunity to earn additional monetary incentive in the form of ‘tips,’ as motivation for repeatedly driving 5-10 minute routes broken up by surveys. Phase 2 added different impairments during driving scenarios and Phase 3 added hazards.
blocks.zh: 数据集分为三个 " 阶段 " ,以下为第一阶段(自然阶段)、第二阶段(自然阶段)和第三阶段(危险阶段)。 从第1阶段开始,参与者驾驶汽车穿过一个城镇,其使命是 " 交付驾驶员 " ,在定位GPS应用后,有机会以 " 提示 " 的形式获得额外的金钱奖励,作为多次驾驶5-10分钟的路线被调查破坏的动机。 第二阶段在驾驶时增加了不同的障碍,第三阶段增加了危险。

blocks.en: Participants were assigned to one of the three collection Phases (between-subjects), and completed a series of ∼ \sim 5-15 minute driving scenarios within that phase – starting in Phase 2, each under a different baseline or impaired condition (within-subjects).
blocks.zh: 与会者被分配到三个收集阶段之一(学科之间),并在该阶段完成了一系列的 \\sim 5-15分钟驾驶方案,从第二阶段开始,每个阶段在不同的基线或受损条件下(学科内部)进行。

blocks.en: Impairment inductions were informed by prior work looking at cross-domain impaired driving study methodologies [ 12 ] , and were separated into three groups: Passive music of the participant’s choice and radio segment; Continuous automated phone call, mailbox scene search, radio comprehension, n-back (1-back) task, and crying baby; and Instantaneous texting pop-ups, visual sinks using props in-simulation (ex. Figure 3 (a); Phase 3 only), and forced GPS reroutes with blocked roads (ex. Figure 3 (b); Phase 3 only). Inductions were framed as secondary tasks where the primary task was driving while following the GPS app.
blocks.zh: 通过研究跨领域障碍驾驶学习方法的以往工作,对障碍入门进行了通报,并分为三类: 参与者选择的被动音乐和无线电部分; 持续的自动电话、邮箱现场搜索、无线电理解、n-back(1-back)任务和哭宝宝; 即时发短信、使用道具模拟的视觉汇(例如图3(a);仅图3阶段),以及用堵路强迫全球定位系统改道(例如图3(b);仅图3阶段)。 上岗培训被设定为次要任务,主要任务在GPS应用程序之后进行。

blocks.en: Starting in Phase 3, we included 21 possible pre-programmed hazards of six categories throughout the map (ex. Figure 3 (c)): red light runners (4), orthogonal parked pop-out cars (5), parallel parked pop-out cars (5), reckless driver (1), cut-off turn hazards (3), and ego vehicle turn hazards (3). The addition of hazards was intended to supplement the unintentional hazards caused by traffic behavior in the other Phases and provide opportunities for interesting combinations of a hazard occurring while a driver is impaired.
blocks.zh: 从第三阶段开始,我们在整个地图(如图3(c))中包括了21种可能预先规划的六类危险:红灯跑车(4)、正交座停放的弹出车(5)、平行座停的弹出车(5)、鲁莽驾驶员(1)、截断转弯危险车(3)和自负车辆转弯危险车(3)。 增加危害是为了补充其他阶段交通行为造成的无意危害,并为驾驶员受损时发生的危害提供有趣的组合机会。

blocks.en: 4.2 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 数据收集

blocks.en: After consenting, participants put on an EmotiBit [ 16 ] , adjusted their simulator seat, and completed gaze calibration. A video introduced the GPS-guided driving task and a practice drive was completed. In Phases 2 and 3, participants additionally watched a video explaining the route timer and performance ’tips’ and watched a video introducing secondary tasks. Each experimental block followed the same structure: participants drove baseline routes, watched the scenario’s secondary task video (Phases 2 and 3 only), drove a GPS-guided route, and completed surveys, including a motion sickness check, shortened NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX) [ 36 ] , Karolinska Sleepiness Scale (KSS) [ 79 ] , and Positive and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS) scale [ 86 ] . Blocks repeated until all scenarios were complete, followed by debriefing (Phases 2 and 3) and compensation.
blocks.zh: 经同意后,与会者穿上了EmotiBit [16],调整了他们的模拟座椅,完成了凝视校准. 一段视频介绍了GPS制导的驾驶任务,并完成了练习驱动. 在第二阶段和第三阶段,与会者还观看了解释路线定时器和性能提示的录像,并观看了介绍次要任务的录像。 每个实验区都遵循同样的结构:参与者驾驶基线路线,观看情景下的二级任务录像(仅第2和第3阶段),驾驶GPS制导路线,完成调查,包括运动疾病检查,缩短NASA任务负载指数(NASA-TLX)[36],Karolinska睡眠指数(KSS)[79],以及正负效应表(PANAS)比例[86]。 在完成所有设想方案之前,重复出现区块,然后是汇报(第2和第3阶段)和补偿。

blocks.en: 4.3 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据集统计

blocks.en: Participant ages ranged from 21 to 66 years (mean of 37.7 and standard deviation of 10.7 years) for 109 completed participants across the three collection Phases (Phase 1 n = 25 n=25 , Phase 2 n = 35 n=35 , Phase 3 n = 49 n=49 ).
blocks.zh: 在三个收集阶段(阶段1 n = 25 n = 25 ,阶段2 n = 35 n = 35 ,阶段3 n = 49 n = 49 ),109名已完成的参与者的参加年龄从21岁到66岁不等(平均37.7岁,标准差10.7 岁)。

blocks.en: To check that our impairments were psychologically noticeable, we compared how NASA-TLX scores differed by impairment type and the mean of each participant’s baseline drives. We used paired t t -tests with Holm-corrections. N-back ( + 5.0 +5.0 , p < .001 p<.001 , d z = 1.94 d_{z}=1.94 ) and radio comprehension ( + 2.5 +2.5 , p < .001 p<.001 , d z = 0.98 d_{z}=0.98 ) raised overall workload. Other impairments had smaller, dimension-specific effects that were not detectable in the overall score. Forced reroute increased time pressure ( + 2.3 +2.3 , p = .013 p=.013 ), baby crying increased frustration ( + 2.5 +2.5 , p = .013 p=.013 ), phone call & scene search increased physical demand ( + 1.3 +1.3 , p = .034 p=.034 ; + 1.4 +1.4 , p = .016 p=.016 ), and music reduced frustration ( − 1.2 -1.2 , p = .020 p=.020 ). These results support that inductions were effective and varied in the types of demand and strength they imposed. Full analysis results are in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了NASA-TLX分数如何因减值类型和每个参与者基准驱动器的平均值而有所不同。 我们用配对T -T测试 与霍尔姆修正。 N-back(+ 5.0+ 5.0,p < 001 p < 001,dz=1.94 d_{z}=1.94)和无线电理解(+2.5+2.5,p < 001 p < 001,dz=0.98 d_{z_{0.98)提高了总体工作量。 其他损伤具有较小的、具体尺寸的影响,在总分中无法察觉。 强制改道增加时间压力(+2.3+2.3,p=013 p=013),婴儿哭泣增加沮丧(+2.5+2.5,p=013 p=013),电话和现场搜索增加物理需求(+1.3+1.3,p=034 p=034;+1.4+1.4,p=016 p=016),音乐减少沮丧(−1.2-1.2,p=020 p=020). 这些结果证明,上岗培训是有效的,其需求类型和实力各不相同。 全面分析结果见补充材料。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We perform experiments on DIVERT (Section 4 ) and, for comparison, IDD [ 30 ] , a driving simulator dataset of cognitive distraction and intoxication. It contains 23.7 hours of data from 52 participants, with gaze, agent trajectories, and scene video. It covers three impairments – a statement understanding task, 1-back, and alcohol intoxication, all of which we consider as continuous impairments.
blocks.zh: 我们进行DIVERT(第4节)的实验,作为比较,IDD[30],是认知分散注意力和中毒的驱动模拟数据集. 其中包括来自52名参与者的23.7小时数据,包括目视、代理轨迹和场景录像。 它包括三种障碍 — — 一种说明性理解任务,即1-back,以及酒精中毒,我们把这些都视为持续性障碍。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Spatial distribution of impairments is imbalanced so location leaks impairment data. We mitigate with paired evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图4:缺陷的空间分布不平衡,因此位置泄露缺陷数据. 我们用配对评价来减轻损失。

blocks.en: For evaluation purposes, we consider baseline driving and passive tasks as negative samples (together considered baseline clips) and continuous impairments as positive. Instantaneous impairments are used as unlabeled data, as their label depends on where the clip falls within the scenario and when the event was triggered. We have focused on 30-second clips following IDD [ 30 ] . DIVERT is divided into five participant-disjoint folds, stratified by Phase, and IDD uses the provided folds. We select three folds as train, one as validation, and one as test. When predicting impairment, all other modalities are provided as clean input. The validation data is used to Z-normalize the logits of each binary head using baseline clips and select the maximum as a sample’s overall level of impairment. We exclude DIVERT practice driving and Phase 1 data from training and evaluation, as they don’t contain any impairment labels.
blocks.zh: 为了评估目的,我们认为基线驱动和被动任务为负样品(共同视为基线短片)和持续损伤为正数。 瞬间减值作为无标签数据使用,因为其标签取决于剪辑在情景中的位置以及事件何时触发. 我们侧重于IDD之后的30秒短片。 DIVERT分为5个参与者-离合折叠,按阶段分级,IDD使用所提供的折叠. 我们选择三个折叠作为火车,一个作为验证,一个作为测试. 在预测减值时,所有其他模式都作为干净的投入提供。 验证数据用于使用基线剪辑对每个二进制头的对数进行Z-正常化,并选择最大值作为样本总的减值水平. 我们把DIVERT的驾驶练习和第一阶段的数据排除在培训和评价之外,因为它们没有包含任何减值标签。

blocks.en:
We then calculate the P-AUC (pooled impairment area under the curve), which represents how likely a model is to rate a continuously impaired clip higher than a baseline clip, equally weighted across impairments. We also calculate each of the ten continuous impairment pairwise combination AUCs and report the mean as I-AUC (impairment vs impairment AUC). These effectively show the model’s ability to detect then differentiate types of impairment (see Supplementary for more detail on metric calculation).
All results use five round-robin runs across the folds over three seeds, with the metrics averaged across all test sets.
blocks.zh:
然后我们计算P-AUC(曲线下的集合减值区),这说明一个模型对一个持续减值的夹片的评分可能比基线夹片高,在各种减值中均匀加权。 我们还计算十种连续减值的双向组合AUC,并将平均值报告为I-AUC(减值对减值AUC)。 这些都有效表明模型有能力检测到然后区分各种类型的减值(关于计量计算的细节,见补充)。
所有结果均使用5个圆形robin在3个种子上横穿折叠线,所有测试组的度量衡均值.

blocks.zh: (a) 侦测AUC。

blocks.zh: (b) ID-MAE配对的AUC。

ID-MAE , No recon. and the MLP are averaged over three seeds; the other baselines are a single run. Bold: best per column. (b) Pairwise location-matched AUCs of ID-MAE on DIVERT , with baseline clips (“Baseline”) as an additional class placed last.

blocks.en: Because DIVERT crosses many impairment types with different routes and each participant drives only a small subset of the combinations, the joint distribution of impairment and route is not uniform. Initial investigations of DIVERT found that a clip’s location and path leaked impairment information, due to this imbalance, as shown in Figure 4 . A logistic regression model trained with coarse location information alone demonstrates this leak with a P-AUC of 0.602 and I-AUC of 0.810. To correct for this, we focus the evaluation on pairs of samples that start near the same location and follow a similar path (see the Supplementary Material for details). We also only sample pairs within Phase to avoid any cohort-level shortcut. When instead using the same coarse location model over these pairs, the performance decreases to a P-AUC of 0.529 and an I-AUC of 0.527, controlling for location leak in the dataset. These 30,929 pairs are released with the dataset. On IDD we use all pairs, as location does not predict impairment (P-AUC of 0.502 0.502 and I-AUC of 0.509 0.509 ).
blocks.zh: 由于DIVERT跨越许多有不同路线的减值类型,每个参与者只驱动一个小子集的组合,减值和路由的联合分布并不一致. DIVERT的初步调查发现,如图4所示,由于这种不平衡,一个剪辑的位置和路径泄露了损坏信息。 仅用粗细位置信息培训的后勤回归模型就表明这种泄漏,P-AUC为0.602,I-AUC为0.810。 为了纠正这种情况,我们把评价的重点放在从同一地点开始并遵循类似路径的对样本上(详情见补充材料)。 我们还在Phase中只做样本对,以避免任何组级的快捷方式. 当在这些对子上使用同样的粗细位置模型时,性能会降低到0.529的P-AUC和0.527的I-AUC,控制数据集中的位置泄漏. 这30,929对是随数据集发布的. 在IDD上,我们使用所有配对,因为位置不会预测损害(P-AUC为0.502 0.502,I-AUC为0.509 0.509)。

It is lower in every test fold on both datasets, by 0.08 0.08 – 0.20 0.20 per fold on DIVERT . Masked reconstruction of the behavioral modalities therefore supplies valuable training signal that label supervision alone does not.

blocks.en: We retrain the publicly released baselines of [ 30 ] on our impairment heads, negatives and folds. ID-MAE leads every baseline on every metric. The gap is largest on DIVERT , where the baselines reach only 0.525 0.525 – 0.571 0.571 P-AUC ( Δ \Delta − 0.135 -0.135 to − 0.181 -0.181 ), close to location only ( 0.529 0.529 ), and 0.624 0.624 – 0.685 0.685 I-AUC ( Δ \Delta − 0.043 -0.043 to − 0.104 -0.104 ). Built on compact hand-crafted features, they remain strong in low-data regimes. On IDD, almost a third the size of leveraged DIVERT data ( 23.7 23.7 vs. 65.1 65.1 hours), they come within 0.044 0.044 – 0.074 0.074 of ID-MAE on P-AUC ( 0.670 0.670 – 0.700 0.700 ) and 0.019 0.019 – 0.086 0.086 on I-AUC ( 0.605 0.605 – 0.672 0.672 ), with the multi-task MLP closest overall and support vector machine (SVM) close on I-AUC.
blocks.zh: 我们重新将公开发布的基线[30] 调整到损伤头、负数和折叠。 ID -MAE是每个度量的基线 在DIVERT上差距最大,其基线仅达到0.525 0.525 – 0.571 0.571 P-AUC(\Delta – 0135-0.135 – 0.181),仅接近位置(0.529 0.529),0.624 – 0.685 0.685 I-AUC(\Delta – 0.043-0.43 – 0.104). 它们以精密手工制作的特征为基础,在低数据制度中仍然很强。 在IDD上,它们几乎是杠杆式DIVERT数据的三分之一(23.7 23.7对65.1 65.1小时),它们在P-AUC上的ID-MAE在0.044 0.044 - 0.074 0.074 0.074 0.070 0.700 0.019 0.019 - 0.086 0.086 0.005 0.605 - 0.672 0.672 ),其多任务 MLP最接近整体和支持向量机(SVM)在I-AUC上关闭.

blocks.en: The impairments form two groups : scene search separates from every other impairment ( 0.89 0.89 – 0.92 0.92 ), whereas n-back, phone call, baby crying and radio comprehension are hard to tell apart ( 0.55 0.55 – 0.63 0.63 ; the exception, n-back vs. baby crying at 0.68 0.68 , rests on only 314 pairs). The groups follow the tasks’ demands. Scene search is a visual task that pulls the eyes off the road, whereas the other four are cognitive , loading attention without a comparable visual demand. Against baseline clips, scene search ( 0.91 0.91 ) is most clearly detected, with n-back ( 0.83 0.83 ) and radio comprehension ( 0.70 0.70 ) having the highest scores among cognitive tasks. Phone call ( 0.64 0.64 ) and baby crying ( 0.60 0.60 ) are only somewhat more distinguishable from baseline clips than from each other.
blocks.zh: 障碍分为两组:场景搜索与其他障碍(0.89 0.89 – 0.92 0.92)分开,而n-back、电话、婴儿哭和无线电理解很难区分(0.55 0.55 – 0.63 0.63;例外,n-back对婴儿哭0.68 0.68,仅停留在314对). 这些团体遵循任务的要求。 场景搜索是一种将眼睛拉到路边的视觉任务,而其他四个则是认知的,在没有可比较的视觉需求的情况下加载注意力. 对照基线片段,场景搜索(0.91 0.91)被最清楚地检测,n-back(0.83 0.83)和无线电理解(0.70 0.70)在认知任务中得分最高. 电话(0.64 0.64)和婴儿哭(0.60 0.60 )与基线剪辑相比,只有略微的区别.

blocks.en: 5.2 Trajectory and Gaze Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 5.2 轨迹和盖兹重建

blocks.en: Besides detecting impairment, ID-MAE reconstructs the masked portions of gaze and trajectory. We mask the last 8 8 s of every vehicle’s trajectory and the driver’s gaze, leaving 22 22 s of context, so the model forecasts 8 8 s ahead, the horizon of the Waymo Open Motion benchmark [ 27 ] . Tables 4 and 5 report the ego vehicle’s average / final displacement error (ADE and FDE, in meters, over the full 8 8 s) and gaze angular error (degrees, over the first 1 1 s and 2 2 s). Because the decoder is a diffusion model, we score both a single rollout and the best of N N (subscript best ; the per-clip minimum, N = 6 N{=}6 as in Waymo); the gap between the two shows how varied its sampled futures are. We evaluate: • ID-MAE with video visible only for the past or for the full clip, plus a single-step (non-diffusion) variant; • Heuristic predictors : constant velocity, training-mean rate (trajectory); context mean, training mean (gaze). Qualitative results are in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 除了检测缺陷外,ID-MAE还重建了蒙面的视线和轨迹部分. 我们掩盖了每辆车最后的八点八分的轨迹和驾驶员的目光,留下了二十二点的上下文,所以模型预测了8点八分的前面,即Waymo开放运动基准的地平线[27]. 表4和表5报告自负飞行器的平均/最后转移误差(ADE和FDE,以米计,在全8个秒以上)和视角误差(度数,在前1个秒和2个秒以上)。 由于解码器是一种扩散模型,我们得分既单次推出,也得分最佳的N N (下标最佳;每盘最小值,N=6N{=}6,如Waymo);两者的差距表明其样本期货的差别有多大. 我们评价: ID-MAE, 视频只显示过去或整个剪辑,加上单步(不扩散)变体; 高压预测器: 恒定速度, 训练-平均率(弹射); 上下文表示,训练表示(gaze)。 定性结果见补充材料。

blocks.en: Every model is far better than the heuristic predictors (constant velocity ADE 10.37 10.37 m, FDE 26.80 26.80 m). Seeing the full video narrows possible futures and helps both decoders, but diffusion gains more (ADE 7.61 → 5.11 7.61\to 5.11 m vs. 7.05 → 5.28 7.05\to 5.28 m). Using the best of six puts diffusion clearly ahead. With past video, its best of six error ( 5.80 5.80 m ADE, 15.17 15.17 m FDE) is 24 24 – 28 % 28\% below its single sample and 13 13 – 15 % 15\% below single-step’s best of six. Single-step’s samples vary only due to input noise, so its best of six gains just 5 5 – 6 % 6\% . With full video, diffusion’s gain shrinks to 7 7 – 9 % 9\% , as fewer futures remain plausible. Best of six is optimistic, but its gain over a single sample shows that diffusion generates diverse rollouts, some close to the ground truth.

blocks.en: Table 6: (a) We perform ablations by changing one aspect of ID-MAE per row. Dropping gaze modality or frame rate, relative positions, or joint training decreases performance, while the other changes have mixed impact. (b) We expand on the per-impairment specialist results – training on one and testing on another.
blocks.zh: 表6:(a) 我们通过修改每一行的ID-MAE的一个方面来进行拼贴。 下降的目视模式或帧率、相对位置或联合培训会降低业绩,而其他变化的影响好坏参半。 (b) 我们扩大每个缺陷专家的结果 -- -- 一个培训,另一个测试。

blocks.en: We perform several ablations, highlighted in Table 6 6(a) (full set in Supplementary). We first examine the impact of the gaze modality, including only using it, dropping it, and reducing its frame rate to 2 Hz to match the video and trajectory modalities. Both general impairment detection and differentiation rely strongly on gaze, with a gaze-only model reaching 0.665 0.665 P-AUC and 0.720 0.720 I-AUC. With trajectory and video added, the I-AUC stays similar, potentially because the strongest impairment differentiation scores come from scene search, a task which gaze is particularly suited to capturing. However, the P-AUC increases substantially. Notably, a model with gaze dropped has near chance performance. Reducing gaze frame rate substantially drops performance, demonstrating the benefit of a flexible model allowing different frame rates for each modality.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了若干活动,如表6(a)(全部载于补充部分)。 我们首先审查凝视模式的影响, 包括只使用它, 降低它, 一般缺陷检测和分化都强烈依赖目视,只视的型号达到0.665 0.665 P-AUC和0.720 0.720 I-AUC. 随着轨迹和视频的增加,I-AUC保持不变,可能是因为最强的减值分数来自场景搜索,这个任务特别适合捕捉. 然而,P-AUC大幅增加。 值得注意的是,一个有目光的模型 几乎是偶然的。 降低视窗帧率会大幅降低性能,表明灵活模式对每种模式允许不同帧率的好处。

blocks.en: The ablations also show a slight benefit of geometric relative position injection over standard global positions. We find that training only with single step prediction results in similar performance to diffusion. While useful for generating trajectory and gaze rollouts, the impact to impairment prediction alone is mixed. Decoding the video tokens does not appear beneficial and increases compute.
blocks.zh: 喷发还表明,几何相对位置的注射略高于标准全球位置。 我们发现,只有单步预测的培训才能产生与传播类似的效果。 虽然对产生轨迹和视线的展开有用,但仅对损害预测的影响是好坏参半的。 解码视频符号似乎没有好处,并增加计算.

blocks.en: We also trained specialist models that each only see one type of impairment and baseline to determine the impact of joint task training. Combining them together during evaluation lowers the P-AUC to 0.687 0.687 , as the trained heads are not calibrated on one another. Specialists retain a similar I-AUC because it is dominated by the scene-search vs. cognitive pairs, which each specialist separates on its own. Figure 6 6(b) shows how much each impairment’s specialist detects the others – showing some transfer between cognitive impairments, but no transfer for scene search.
blocks.zh: 我们还培训了专家模型,每个模型只看到一种类型的缺陷和基线,以确定联合任务培训的影响。 在评价期间将它们合并起来,使P-AUC降低到0.687 0.687,因为训练有素的头头没有相互校准。 专家保留了一个相似的I-AUC,因为它以场景搜索与认知对称为主,每个专家单独分离. 图6 6(b)显示每个缺陷的专家检测到其他缺陷的多少 — — 显示认知障碍之间的一些转移,但没有进行现场搜索的转移。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ID-MAE , a multimodal masked diffusion autoencoder that jointly models impairment, gaze, trajectory, and video, and DIVERT , a driving-simulator dataset of 109 drivers under ten impairment inductions.
We demonstrated how subtle, data-limited tasks such as impairment detection can leverage supervision from adjacent tasks, improving paired detection from 0.590 0.590 to 0.706 0.706 AUC, while also enabling gaze and trajectory prediction.
The impairments and hazards in DIVERT open several directions we are eager to explore: detecting impairment at lower latency, analyzing how impairment impacts behavior under hazards, and investigating the role of language through further annotations and modeling.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了ID-MAE, 一种多模式遮盖的传播自动编码器, 联合模型 减值、视线、轨迹和视频,
我们示范了诸如缺陷检测等微妙、数据有限的任务如何能利用相邻任务的监督,改进配对检测,从0.590 0.590提高到0.706 0.706,同时还能够进行视线和轨迹预测。
DIVERT的缺陷和危害开启了我们渴望探索的几个方向:在低延迟时检测缺陷,分析缺陷如何影响危害下的行为,并通过进一步的说明和模型研究语言的作用.
